title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. my name is Muhammad Asif Mehmood I have a son, his name is Abdul Rafay, now Allah blessed me with a daughter and i want to give her islamic name please advise. 2402 views Q. My son name is Muhammad Huzaifa, is this a good name. My name is Mohd Irshad, my wife name is Mehrun Nisa and my son D.O.B is 12th May 2007. If not a good name then Please. Advise a suitable name. 4352 views Q. AOA.. I want to keep my daughter's name as "Raadiyen". Its the name of one of the doors of Jannat through which 'Zakiriyen' will enter. Can I keep this name and is this correct through Shariat? 1816 views Q. I want to know the details of two names; boy name Zain and girl name Reyanna. Are these good names from Islamic perspective. Should we keep these names of our children or change them? 5241 views Q. I am going to have a baby in December if Allah wishes. If it is a boy I am thinking of keeping his name ‘Umar Bin Sajjad’ and if it is a girl then I will be keeping it as ‘Aisha Bint Sajjad’. What is your saying? 1908 views Q. can i name my daughter azeemah wht is the meaning? 1800 views Q. Keeping Name Mateen 3446 views Q. What is the meaning and spelling of Ariz Rahman? 4245 views Q. Name for my Baby boy 9800 views Q. Assalam Alaikum, I would like to know the meanings of these names ZAHAAN (for Boy, I think it should be INTELLIGENT) KASHAF (for girl, I think it should be MOJIZA) Kindly assist in this regard. Jazak Allah 2771 views Q. Please guide me. I pick my daughter name aakifah. Is this a good name according to islam? Or should i pick some other name like khudija, ummaikulthum, asma, busayrah. zakiya. please give me some guidence because my older daughter name is ummai habiba and my older son name is ikrama and little one is usman so please hepl me out soon as posible. 2190 views Q. اصفا فاطمہ (Aasfa fathima) نام کے بارے میں بتائیں۔کیا یہ نام شریعت کی روشنی میں درست ہے؟براہ کرم، کوئی ایسا نام بتائیں جو بہت زیادہ اچھا ہو اور اس کے بہت سارے فضائل ہوں۔ میں اپنی بیٹی کا نام رکھنا چاہتاہوں جو کل پیدا ہوئی ہے۔ 1764 views Q. I have kept my son's name as Asad Ahmed, is it ok or need to keep Asadullah? 2395 views Q. میں نے اپنے بیٹوں کے نام احمد مصطفی اور محمد رکھا ہے، کیا یہ درست ہے؟ 1778 views Q. Now a day's its common practice to change the girls name after marriage from father's name to husband's name, is it halaal? 2562 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 57038 Country: India Title: مجھے صوفیہ (Sofia) ، شایان (Shayan) اور شنجل (Shanjal)، کے معنی بتائیں اورلڑکی کے کچھ اچھے نام بھی بتائیں۔ Question: مجھے صوفیہ (Sofia) ، شایان (Shayan) اور شنجل (Shanjal)، کے معنی بتائیں اورلڑکی کے کچھ اچھے نام بھی بتائیں۔ Answer ID: 57038 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 241-275/L=3/1436-U صوفیہ کے معنی متقی پرہیزگار، شایان کے معنی لائق،موزوں ہیں او رشنجل کے معنی لغت میں نہیں مل پائے۔ بچیوں کے اچھے نام درج ذیل ہیں،مریم، آسیہ، رضوانہ، خدیجہ، فاطمہ، رقیہ، حبیبہ، سودہ، سلمہ، عائشہ، میمونہ، صفیہ، حفصہ۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
